einzeiler: A 20-part podcast series exploring the human stories of World War II with Tom Hanks.
kurzfassung: Tom Hanks presents a 20-part podcast series examining the profound human impact of World War II. The series highlights stories of extreme human suffering alongside extraordinary sacrifice and heroism. Listeners can experience comprehensive accounts of the global conflict on major podcast platforms.
stichpunkte: World War II lasted for six years and stands as the largest event in human history
No part of the globe or human life remained untouched by the conflict
The series focuses on the true human cost and individual stories of those who lived through it
Humanity was displayed at both its absolute worst and its absolute best
Many individuals demonstrated a willingness to sacrifice their lives for others
The podcast is presented as a 20-part series hosted by Tom Hanks
Episodes are made available on Apple, Spotify, and other podcast platforms

clips.text: For six dark years, the world was on fire. The Second World War is the largest event in human history. A 20-part series with Tom Hanks. No part of the globe was untouched.

clips.hook: We saw human beings at their absolute worst and best.
clips.text: We saw human beings at their absolute worst. But we also saw them at their absolute best. Willing to sacrifice their lives so that others may live.

clips.hook: No part of the globe was untouched, and no life unchanged.
clips.text: No part of the globe was untouched. No life unchanged. It's easy to lose sight of the true cost of those years. The human cost.

clips.hook: Every single person had a story that makes us who we are.
clips.text: Experience the ultimate account of World War II. Every single person had a story. These are the stories that make us who we are. This is World War II.

beschreibung: Coming May 26th: World War II with Tom Hanks reexamines history’s most devastating conflict for a new century. Across twenty hours, the series traces the war’s full arc–from the rise of fascism to Hiroshima–uncovering the decisions, hidden networks, and lasting consequences that continue to shape our world.
